$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-overlay-two-versions.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). Covers the OverlayKey: (MapName, MapVersion) together identify an overlay, so the SAME MapName may appear twice with different MapVersion and the two are distinct overlays, not a duplicate. Both carry a full 2x2 payload with different tokens, so a reader that collapsed them by MapName alone would keep only one and the cells would differ.
